name: source
description: Displays citations and references for an AI response. `Source` renders a single citation; `Sources` renders a numbered list with an overflow count.
designIntent: Make generated answers transparent by showing where information came from.

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: Maximum number of references to show before an overflow indicator.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based citation marker rendered as [n]; omit on Source to hide numbering.

examples.title: Citations list
examples.code: <Sources sources={[{ id: '1', title: 'React docs', url: 'https://react.dev' }, { id: '2', title: 'MDN', url: 'https://developer.mozilla.org' }]} />

examples.title: Single inline citation
examples.code: <Source source={{ id: '1', title: 'React docs', url: 'https://react.dev' }} index={1} />

antiPatterns.title: Do not nest Sources inside Sources
antiPatterns.explanation: Sources is a list container; compose individual Source items only when building a custom layout.

accessibility.implementation: References use native links with rel=noopener when URLs are provided.
[n] citation markers are aria-hidden; titles are read as link text.
